title: The Treehouse Mystery

pages.text: "I can't find my backpack anywhere!" said Maya with a worried look on her face.
pages.scene: A young girl searching frantically through her bedroom, looking under the bed.

pages.text: "Don't worry," said her brother Ben. "We'll find it together before lunchtime today."
pages.scene: A kind older brother putting his hand on his sister's shoulder reassuringly.

pages.text: Maya thought someone might have taken it into the treehouse outside.
pages.scene: Maya looking out the window at a wooden treehouse in the backyard.

pages.text: "I'm sure it's in the treehouse," she said. "Let's go look without any delay."
pages.scene: Maya pointing excitedly toward the backyard treehouse through the kitchen door.

pages.text: They walked into the sunshine and climbed up the ladder to the treehouse.
pages.scene: Two children climbing a wooden ladder up to a treehouse in a big oak tree.

pages.text: "It isn't here," said Ben. "But look! There's a footprint on the floor."
pages.scene: Ben pointing at a muddy footprint on the wooden treehouse floor.

pages.text: "That's strange," Maya said. "I didn't make that footprint. Did you make it?"
pages.scene: Maya crouching down to examine the mysterious footprint closely.

pages.text: "No, I didn't," Ben replied. "Someone else must've been here without us knowing."
pages.scene: Ben shaking his head, both children looking puzzled and curious.

pages.text: They heard something moving in the bushes outside, and it wasn't the wind.
pages.scene: Both children looking out the treehouse window at rustling bushes below.

pages.text: "We're going to solve this mystery," Maya whispered. "I won't give up now."
pages.scene: Maya with a determined expression, whispering to her brother.

pages.text: They climbed down and tiptoed into the garden without making any noise at all.
pages.scene: The children sneaking quietly through the garden toward the bushes.

pages.text: Behind the rosebush, they found their dog Biscuit holding Maya's backpack in his mouth.
pages.scene: A golden retriever sitting happily with a backpack in its mouth.

pages.text: "It's Biscuit!" Maya laughed. "He's the one who took my backpack from my bedroom!"
pages.scene: Maya laughing and reaching for her backpack while Biscuit wags his tail.

pages.text: "You shouldn't take things that aren't yours," Ben said to the silly dog.
pages.scene: Ben wagging his finger playfully at the dog, smiling.

pages.text: Biscuit didn't seem sorry at all, because he couldn't understand their words anyway.
pages.scene: Biscuit tilting his head innocently, tongue out, looking happy.

pages.text: "I'll forgive you this time," said Maya, "but you'd better not do it again."
pages.scene: Maya hugging Biscuit while pretending to look stern.

pages.text: They're such a funny team, Maya thought, looking at Ben and Biscuit together.
pages.scene: Ben and Biscuit playing in the garden, Maya watching and smiling.

pages.text: Everyone went inside for lunchtime sandwiches that Mom had made with care.
pages.scene: The family sitting at the kitchen table eating sandwiches together.

pages.text: "What's for dessert?" asked Ben. "I hope it's something chocolate because that's my favorite."
pages.scene: Ben looking hopefully at his mom while finishing his sandwich.

pages.text: "You'll have to wait and see," Mom said with a smile on her face.
pages.scene: Mom smiling mysteriously, holding a covered dish.

pages.text: "I don't think I can wait!" Maya said. "I'm too hungry for more waiting!"
pages.scene: Maya bouncing in her seat with anticipation.

pages.text: It wasn't just chocolate cake. It was homemade brownies with ice cream on top!
pages.scene: A plate of brownies with scoops of ice cream, children looking delighted.

pages.text: "We didn't expect this!" the children said. "You're the best mom in everything!"
pages.scene: Children hugging their mom, brownies on the table, happy family scene.

pages.text: And that afternoon, everyone went back outside to play in the sunshine together.
pages.scene: The whole family playing in the backyard with Biscuit, sunny day.
